create.name: Annie B. Bond
create.bio:
Annie B. Bond is an energy and sound healer and the founder of Awakening Prana, a system of energy work that uses light, colour, sound and the elements to clear the chakras, the central channel and the wider energy field. Before turning to healing she was known as a writer on green, low-toxin living, publishing five books on healthy homes and sustainable lifestyles, including Better Basics for the Home and Home Enlightenment, and writing for many magazines and websites. Her energy training began with Reiki in 1999 and went on through One Light Healing Touch, sound healing with Zacciah Blackburn, Kundalini yoga, Judith Blackstone's Realization work and empowerments from the 17th Karmapa.

She now teaches the Awakening Prana Path to Healing, a six-month live online training for people who want to work with energy for themselves and others, along with short courses on dowsing, the hara and thought patterns, and a monthly group healing circle. Her book Awakening Prana! 9 Steps to Regenerative Self-Transformation sets out her method, and on her YouTube channel she shares sound practices, meditations and conversations, including the Stoneman Diaries, teachings she receives from a guide she calls Stoneman. She has also taught on The Shift Network.

books.title: Awakening Prana!: 9 Steps to Regenerative Self-Transformation
books.author: Annie B. Bond
books.description: Annie B. Bond's guide to her Awakening Prana method, which links the body's bioelectric charges with life force energy, or prana. In nine steps it describes the energy lines and the wider grid they connect to, with processes for activating them in daily practice.

courses.title: Awakening Prana: Path to Healing, Level I
courses.description: A six-month training of six live weekends on Zoom, 90 hours in all, for people who want to facilitate Awakening Prana energy work for themselves and others. It includes a manual, a student community and lifetime access to the recordings.

courses.title: Matrix of Your Mind: Hara Healing
courses.description: An on-demand course with a companion workbook on noticing unconscious thought patterns and shifting them through energy work on the hara. It is aimed at sensitive people and needs no previous experience.

courses.title: Foundations of Dowsing
courses.description: A short online course of 27 lessons that presents dowsing as a way into intuition and contact with the higher self. Students learn to dowse clearly and consistently for simple answers; an option adds half an hour with Annie.

courses.title: Self-Regeneration Monthly Healing Circle
courses.description: A live one-hour group session on Zoom on the last Tuesday of each month. Each circle teaches one energy technique by experience so participants can use it again, and registrants receive the recording.

free_resources.title: Activating Your Bioelectric Energy Body (e-book)
free_resources.description: A free e-book from the Stoneman Diaries on working with the sacred elements to activate the energy body and reconnect with Source. It is sent after signing up with a name and email address.

free_resources.title: Energy Healing Meditations
free_resources.description: Nine guided meditations to download, including the Pranic Tube, Pyramid of Light, Hara System and 3 Hearts meditations. They run from about five to thirty-seven minutes.

free_resources.title: Path to Healing Open House (replay)
free_resources.description: A recorded open house in which Annie introduces some of the tools taught in the Path to Healing training. The replay is available after registering.

flags: Reputation does not match follower counts: she has a Wikipedia article, five best-selling green-living books, and her Shift profile claims a newsletter of one million readers; personal Facebook and X counts could not be read.

Her only current Shift course, Trinity Energy Healing, was left out because its module descriptions name anxiety, personality disorders and addictive attachments; a human may decide to include it with a clean description.
Path to Healing Level I is subtitled 'Applied Consciousness Medicine training' on its page; kept under its plain title as it names no condition, but flagged under the 'medical' rule.
Location unclear: her site says she lives in Amesbury, Massachusetts, but also that her healing centre is in Rhinebeck, New York; listed as worldwide since her teaching is online.

Prices on her site show without a currency code (euro is shown to Portugal visitors); USD assumed as she is US-based. The healing circle page also lists an annual subscription (EUR 99 in the euro view).
Several videos are channelled teachings from 'Stoneman' (a Hathor guide) and the 'Lunch on the Path' series is co-hosted with Trinette Mitchell, her programme director.
left_out: Trinity Energy Healing (Shift Network, self-paced): description names anxiety, personality disorders and addictive attachments.
Manifest Happiness: Healing Trauma with Auric Field Clearing: trauma in the title.
Path to Healing Level II (October 2025 to March 2026): passed. Energy of Place space-clearing course (July to August 2026): passed; its page also names alcoholism and depression.
New Shift Network programme (January 2027): no page or URL yet.

Videos naming conditions or body problems: Your Negative Thoughts Are Increasing Your Cortisol; The Energetic Approach to a Damaged Nervous System; Heal Your Glands Using Consciousness, Sound & the Elements; Stoneman on Food, Weight & Energy; How the Energy Body Responds to Change, Stress, and Addiction.

Green-living books (Better Basics for the Home, ASIN 0609803255 verified on Amazon; Home Enlightenment; True Food; Clean and Green): no Spiritpedia subject fits; Home Enlightenment, True Food and Clean and Green /dp/ pages returned errors and were not verified.
One-to-one healing sessions at the Awakening Prana Center: not her main way of working.
Chakra Healing Guide and sound-healing downloads on her site: not checked as free.
